description: Aider-polyglot style (Java): implement an LRU cache with per-entry TTL on an injected clock from a stub and an instructions file - expiry exactly at stored time plus ttl, get refreshing recency but not the ttl, expired entries dropped before any live entry is evicted (even a recently used expired one), containsKey/size/keys not touching recency, replacing a live key at capacity evicting nothing, and saturating ttl arithmetic. A protected run_tests.py compiles with javac and runs the plain-Java test runner; the post-turn verifier gives a failing first attempt a repair round, like aider's second try.
